summary: Measured NEAR testnet RPC round-trip latency across 5 probes: min 12.4 ms, max 301.2 ms, mean 99.9 ms. The accompanying CSV data table lists one row per region with its latency in milliseconds; the spread (288.8 ms) shows why a single-region estimate is unreliable for finality-sensitive work. Sources are the public testnet RPC endpoints and the NEAR documentation, cited below. Full per-region figures are in the CSV; this summary stays within the 300-word acceptance limit.
